speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. Can you describe the nature of your left shoulder pain and how long you have been experiencing it?

speaker: Patient
text: I’ve had this dull ache in my left shoulder for about two months now, and it seems to get worse when I try to move my arm fully. speaker: Doctor
text: Given the chronic nature, night pain, and difficulty with overhead activities like brushing your hair, this strongly suggests rotator cuff pathology or adhesive capsulitis. DIAGNOSIS READY: Rotator Cuff Tendinopathy
